title: Specified compact-support base-change maps and normalization
statement: For a commutative condensed ring Lambda, use the ordinary derived module pullback, compactification proper/open composite, and literal compactification pullback. Define the proper exchange to be the published ambient mate. Define the inverse open exchange by the open unit, canonical square comparison and base-changed open counit. Regard a quasi-compact compactification as a boundary compactification. Define the comparison family by the uniquely common-dense-refinement-normalized coherence theorem, restricted to Loc(Dctf), and define the compact-support exchange as the proper mate followed by proper pushforward of the normalized open isomorphism. These are the seven existing constructions of det-sf-comp-composition-base-change, separated into a common interface. The composite omits identity-component associators, by the proved generic equality with the original formula. The generic data structure packages the explicitly constructed map with its component equality and isomorphism API; it is not selected from existence. The common-refinement normalization and refinement invertibility are exposed as proved properties of the specified comparison.

source.place: Clauses (1)--(3), with component and common-refinement normalization APIs.

proof.text: Construct the proper/open composite from the two whiskered transformations. Its component formula is reflexive; composition and functoriality preserve component isomorphisms. Componentwise identity of associators identifies it with the original four-arrow formula.

Project the refinement invertibility and common-dense-refinement normalization clauses of the specified coherence theorem. The normalization is for the family selected in the definition of the canonical comparison.

lean.note: The original seven constructions are reexported unchanged mathematically. Compact support uses its original body as a reducible abbreviation so object indices normalize before derived-functor applications. The literal proper square is directly constructed once and shared. The composite uses directly constructed CompactSupportExchangeData with its component API; the generic associator equality preserves the original map. Proved comparison-normalization APIs avoid consumer unfolding.
